headline: Antam Finance Director Speaks Candidly on 46% Profit Surge to Rp9,7 Trillion
summary: PT Antam (Persero) Tbk reported consolidated net profit of Rp9.7 trillion through the third quarter of 2026, a 46% increase. The finance director discussed the results.
why: Antam is a state-owned Indonesian miner of gold, nickel and other minerals, so its profits track commodity prices and output.
original_headline: Dirkeu Antam Blak-blakan Soal Lonjakan Laba 46% Jadi Rp9,7 Triliun
